Decision: Pay Per Ride/Minute

Justification: For 3 selected rides, pay-per-use costs $5.85 vs. $29 monthly membership. The membership is 4.5x more expensive for this usage level. Break-even occurs when total pay-per-use exceeds $29 - calculate 29 / (1 + 0.19*avg_minutes_per_ride). With 3 rides, the per-ride cost ($1 + $0.19*avg_minutes) is already cheaper than the membership. Weekly summary: 3 rides/month = ~1 ride/week, which remains below break-even. Caveats: Membership includes 45 free minutes; actual cost depends on ride durations not provided here.
